integrity: Proof contains universal classification, sharp deterministic boundary, exact multinomial expression, fixed-small-group asymptotic, and Gaussian boundary limit; direct exhaustive finite enumeration is independent corroboration only.
limitations: Two groups whose membership may vary; exactly two indivisible items and additive ±1 item values. Stochastic statements require independently uniformly distributed sign pairs, group sizes may vary with population; no broader heterogeneous-magnitude or multi-item claim.
title: Exact feasibility and a one-quarter group-size transition for two signed indivisible items
